verification_policy: Bounded current-evidence mechanics enrichment for four previously placeholder-length mentor records; no unsupported timing, probabilities, hidden gates, or frame data promoted.

records.name: Fighting Pose A
records.mechanics_notes: 0-Ki Power Up Super. Grants temporary automatic guard for 12 seconds after activation.

records.name: Fighting Pose F
records.mechanics_notes: 0-Ki Power Up Super. Grants Hyper Armor for 12 seconds; incoming damage temporarily depletes Stamina instead of Health, while Stamina regeneration is greatly reduced.

records.name: Innocence Cannon
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Ki Blast Super. Fires a large straight Ki ball; on hit it launches the opponent across the map. Current skill-specific evidence reports 30% damage.

records.name: Justice Rush
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Strike Super. Opens with a brief stance, then delivers a 10-hit rush: nine strikes followed by a final knockback kick. Current skill-specific evidence reports 15% damage and notes that an Ultimate can be input before the last kick.
